prompt: Objective: assess whether the plant-based meat industry is attractive. What you've learned: sales grew fast until 2021 and have fallen since. Latest finding: repeat purchase rates are low. What is the best next step?

options.text: Project industry sales over the next five years
options.feedback: That jumps ahead before understanding why sales fell.

options.text: Size the marketing spend of each brand
options.feedback: Secondary: low repeat purchase is the finding.

options.text: Find out why buyers don't come back
options.feedback: Right. Low repeat purchases explain the decline; find out why buyers don't return.

options.text: Find out why so few new buyers try the products
options.feedback: Trial isn't the problem; repeat is.

explanation: Sales fell after 2021 and repeat purchases are low. Find out why buyers don't come back.
